info.name: Vaults for Cryptomator
info.summary: Your Cryptomator vaults in the Files app, to browse and change; the password never leaves the browser
info.description:
Browse, preview, download, upload, rename, move and delete the files of a Cryptomator vault stored in your Nextcloud, in the Files app, without installing Cryptomator.
- **In Files:** *Vaults* in the navigation lists your vaults; an unlocked vault is browsed in Files' own list, with its folders, breadcrumbs, sorting and grid view - **Recognised as you open it:** a vault's folder in your files shows a notice that opens the vault - **Unlocked in your browser:** the password, the vault's keys and every decrypted name and file stay in the browser tab; the server only sends the encrypted files, as it does for Cryptomator itself - **Locks itself** after 15 minutes without use, when you choose Lock (above the list of an open vault), or when you leave the page - **Upload files and folders, new folders, rename, move, delete:** files are encrypted in your browser and written as Cryptomator writes them, each checked before it enters the vault; a file of the same name is replaced only when you say so; large files go in pieces, whatever their size - **Previews** of pictures, PDFs, text, audio, video, Word documents and spreadsheets, made in your browser - Vault format 8 (Cryptomator 1.6 and later), both cipher combinations
Not affiliated with Skymatic GmbH, the makers of Cryptomator.
info.author: Dawid Ciepiela
